pulse.text: **Nothing has shipped since Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3 landed Aug 14** and the board is unchanged - Claude Opus 5 leads the index at **63**, Fable 5 at 62, Grok 4.6 and GPT-5.6 Sol tied at 61 - but the cheapest serious API is about to stop being cheap: DeepSeek's peak/off-peak restructure takes effect **Aug 16 at 16:00 UTC**, moving V4-Pro from $0.435/$0.87 per 1M to **$1.32/$3.96 at peak** and V4-Flash from $0.14/$0.28 to $0.44/$1.32, roughly 3x to 4.5x increases from the lab that set the industry's price floor, with off-peak rates half of peak. On the business side, CNBC reported OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar told investors that **enterprise revenue has now passed consumer**, crossing months earlier than the year-end parity she projected in the spring. Release odds drifted rather than moved: Google's Gemini 3.5 Pro slid again to **18% from 20%** for Aug 31, a seventh straight decline, while the next Mythos-class model firmed to 74% from 72% by Sep 30 and Anthropic's end-of-September best-model contract ticked up to 88%. GPT-6 gave back a point to 82% by Dec 31 with the Sep 30 leg at 38%, Astra held at 73% by Sep 30, and Manifold's AGI-before-2028 market eased to 16.5% from 17%. Kalshi rate-limited a sixth straight sweep, so Grok 4.7's 43%-by-Sep-4 is still carried forward unverified.
